Title: Azure DevTest Labs now available in more regions

Body.Content:
Azure DevTest Labs is now available in the UAE North, Germany West Central and Norway East regions. The support includes full Azure DevTest Labs capabilities. To see all supported regions for DevTest Labs, see Azure products available by region.

Get started by visiting the DevTest Labs documentation.

Try it today and let us know what you think. If you have questions, please post them on the Azure DevTest Labs forum.
